Folks — forwarding Samira’s ask. Quick take:

- From an infra perspective, 10–14 concurrent slots is fine for Dedicated sizing. The runtime can autoscale to burst but billing for reserved capacity vs burst needs to be explicit in the SOW.
- The 5% hard cap on GPU cost pass-through during the pilot is aggressive given current market volatility; we typically model a 10% corridor for short pilots unless the customer accepts a price-reset trigger or agrees to scheduled reviews.
- Alternatives: 1) Reduce pass-through cap to 7.5% but include a one-time true-up if GPU spot spikes >12% for >7 days; 2) Keep 5% cap but limit it to baseline committed units only (no billing pass-through on burst).

I’ve sketched both options in the pricing workbook and flagged where finance sign-off will be required. Recommend commercial present a 2-option path to Nova: conservative (lower cap + true-up) and firm (5% on committed only).

-Karthik
VP, Serving Runtime
